title: agent-resurrect resume --json
description: A resume request. --json implies --print: nothing is ever launched, and session.resume.command is the command to run in a terminal pane. action: printed (exit 0), refused (exit 1 unknown agent, 5 busy, 6 gone; the session is still included). On exit 3 (no such session, or nothing recorded for this pane) action and session are null.
